features.name: Fix BUG-2: Analytics Trends API 500 + Report tab filter dropdowns crash
features.description: Two follow-up bugs reported after the 2026-07-05 inspection run. (1) Analytics Trends: GET /api/analytics/trend returned HTTP 500 because the AnalyticsService used bare '?' placeholders inside '? IS NULL OR col = ?' expressions, which PostgreSQL cannot infer types for ('could not determine data type of parameter $2'). Replaced the static TREND_SQL constant with the same dynamic WHERE-clause builder (appendScopeFilters) already used by the sibling methods getChannelBreakdown/getTopEmployees. (2) PDF report tab: ReportRepository.getCampaigns() and getEmployees() called DioClient.get<List<dynamic>>(...) and treated the response body itself as a list, but the backend wraps every list response in the standard ApiResponse envelope { success, message, data: [...] }. Result: reportSchoolsProvider and reportEmployeesProvider crashed when the Analytics Trends card or any report form opened with a 'String is not a subtype of Map' or 'Iterable.map on Map' error. Fixed by unwrapping via res.data!['data'] as List<dynamic>, mirroring getSchools(). Also dropped the unsupported 'size=100' param (GET /api/v1/campaigns only accepts includeArchived) and corrected 'size' to 'limit' for /api/v1/schools (the param name the backend actually uses).

knownIssues.issue: Storage backend still uses Firebase GCS despite feat-072 MinIO migration
knownIssues.note: StorageService uses GCS SDK (storage.googleapis.com URLs). MinioConfig provides S3Client but is unused. Effects: (1) /api/v1/storage/upload-url returns GCS presigned URLs that fail when FE attempts upload; (2) StorageService.uploadGeneratedObject fails for PDF reports because the Firebase bucket 'vnmap-campaign.appspot.com' does not exist; (3) feat-079 avatar upload is broken at the upload step. Need to rewrite StorageService.generateUploadUrl() + uploadGeneratedObject() + generateDownloadUrl() to use S3Presigner/S3Client (AWS SDK v2) and the MinIO endpoint.

Spring's NoResourceFoundException is not mapped in GlobalExceptionHandler, so GET /api/v1/foo-bar returns 500 instead of 404. Add @ExceptionHandler(NoResourceFoundException.class) returning HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND.

FE may rely on a list endpoint (e.g. /api/v1/reports with pagination). Currently only POST /api/v1/reports/campaigns/pdf exists; there is no list. Add: GET /api/v1/reports?page&limit&status returning paged list of report jobs for the current user.
